# Platform consumer fixtures — TEST ONLY

Byte-exact UTF-8, no final newline. No producer or production data. Synthetic
catalogue keys and UUIDs. Parsed at deterministic Unix second 1794000000.
`valid/` pins all six families, visible safe zero, suppression, incomplete,
player/unknown attribution, replace/erase and watermark. `invalid/` pins canonical,
member/type/depth/size/row/page bounds, invalid IDs, enums, buckets and digests.
These are Platform-owned consumer fixtures under accepted contract §10.8;
they do not certify the Game producer. Resync fixtures await its accepted envelope
(§10.6), and are deliberately absent.
